purpose: Modern observed low-frequency inputs, with their usable spatial/absolute response separated

obtained_file.kind: observed compact-source catalogue, not diffuse map
obtained_file.inspection: Binary-table NAXIS2 and TFIELDS in downloaded FITS header; no derived flux statistic claimed.

sources.kind: interferometric wide-area images; resolved morphology without measured monopole
sources.priority_for_lowsky: high for matched spatial structure at 36.528 and 46.992 MHz; no absolute-temperature comparison
sources.resolution: approximately 15-25 arcmin, varies with frequency and declination
sources.scale_response: Eastwood et al. explicitly say the maps are made solely from interferometric data and do not represent globally averaged sky brightness; model comparison requires removal/filtering of large-scale modes or an instrument transfer function.
sources.bright_source_policy: Cyg A, Cas A, Vir A, Tau A, Her A, Hya A, 3C 123 and 3C 353 removed; solar 2-degree-radius region blanked.
sources.calibration: Cyg A point-source flux sets scale; LAMBDA quotes 5-10% flux-scale error. This is not an absolute diffuse-temperature error bar.
sources.data_status: verified URL and size by HEAD, not downloaded

sources.kind: degree-resolution diffuse maps with total-power scale restoration
sources.priority_for_lowsky: highest modern spatial/brightness comparison in 35-50 MHz overlap
sources.scale_response: LWA1 corrected missing interferometric spacings with LEDA total-power measurements and forward modelling; unlike OVRO-LWA this product attempts an absolute diffuse-temperature map.
sources.calibration: 15-25% conservative survey calibration; per-frequency pixel-uncertainty files are available but do not replace shared absolute-scale uncertainty.
sources.data_status: verified listing and direct map/error URLs; not downloaded in modern pass

sources.kind: interferometric 42-66-MHz field images and source catalogue; compact/small-scale emission
sources.priority_for_lowsky: secondary source/morphology control around 50 MHz in the released HETDEX footprint
sources.coverage: 650 square degrees in HETDEX spring field in DR1; survey ambition is wider, but unreleased area is not data
sources.resolution: 15 arcsec; typical off-source rms about 1.6 mJy/beam
sources.scale_response: No total-power zero spacing in the public mosaic; a low-resolution source-subtracted mosaic is available but is still not a calibrated Galactic monopole or degree-scale absolute sky map.

sources.kind: new 15-30-MHz LOFAR field images and observed source catalogue; compact/sub-degree emission
sources.priority_for_lowsky: highest modern 10-30-MHz source-population test; unsuitable for absolute diffuse-sky pixels
sources.coverage: 40 released northern fields; full-survey target is declination above +20 degrees, but current release is partial
sources.scale_response: Interferometric images lack total-power zero spacing. Use catalogue for resolved/compact source population and targeted small-scale morphology only; field-dependent ionospheric losses affect fluxes.
sources.flux_systematic: Paper recommends an additional 39% systematic flux-density uncertainty for bright, compact, isolated sources; catalogue columns contain statistical errors only. Poor-quality fields are excluded from final source catalogue.
sources.data_status: source catalogue downloaded and FITS header inspected; mosaics not downloaded

sources.kind: absolute beam-averaged radiometer spectra, not resolved map
sources.priority_for_lowsky: adjacent-band absolute-scale check at and above 60 MHz; outside current 1-50-MHz drop-in range
sources.observable: calibrated antenna temperature versus frequency and local sidereal time with machine-readable antenna radiation patterns
sources.scale_response: Suitable only after convolving the model with the published frequency-dependent antenna pattern and matching observed LST/sky exposure. Do not compare a single sky pixel or apply paper's GSM2016 correction factors directly to lowsky.
sources.published_result: Reported corrected absolute-brightness 1-sigma uncertainty below 2% at 60-150 MHz; this is for its beam-weighted radiometric result, not 50-MHz map pixels.
sources.data_status: archive DOI identified from primary paper, direct machine-data file not verified or downloaded
